title: machine-read-object
description: NX-062 M4a (ADR-041 amendment A1): the answer of POST /machine/v1/read with verb object.get - one object of the key's world. Only metadata and the properties registered for the object's type in the verb's projection (control.nexloop_machine_read_verbs), applied in SQL (authz.nexloop_machine_read): never a free text, a message reference, an external order id, a contact or an internal executor; a value naming a Consumer being erased is left out; an owner-restricted property group is never returned. Machine reads are open for Commitment and CommercialRecord only. Tenant, world and actor come from the key. NexLoop target contract; server-derived identity required.
